label: Newton, Def. iii iv, for uniform motion: whatever being a body perseveres in a state of uniform…
paraphrase: Newton, Def. III-IV, for uniform motion: whatever being a body perseveres in a state of uniform rectilinear motion by is the body itself (it perseveres by its inherent force, the force of inertia, alone; an impressed force does not remain in it after the action). It says nothing about whether the perseverance is a being moved, and asserts no persevering body.
